overview: The Medford Traffic Commission met to review several parking petitions and regulations. The commission approved two accessible parking spaces, parking restrictions on Foss Street and Commercial Street, a commercial vehicle parking variance, and designated on-street parking spaces on Park Street to eliminate parking on sidewalks.

items.title: Handicap Parking Sign: 20 Lookout Road
items.summary: Approved a handicapped parking sign request at 20 Lookout Road for an elderly resident lacking driveway access.

items.title: Handicap Parking Sign: 355 Main Street
items.summary: Removed from the table and approved a handicapped parking sign request for 355 Main Street.

items.title: No Parking Tow Zone: Foss Street
items.summary: Approved a no parking anytime tow zone on the even side of Foss Street from Fellsway West to Guild Street to address safety issues and allow emergency vehicles to pass.

items.title: Commercial Vehicle Parking Variance: 93 Walcott Street
items.summary: Approved a one-year commercial vehicle overnight parking permit variance for a work van with company lettering at 93 Walcott Street, despite commissioner concerns over broader policy implications.

items.title: Parking Regulations: Park Street
items.summary: Approved parking restrictions and designated on-street parking segments on Park Street between Fellsway West and Brogan Road to end habitual parking on sidewalks.

items.title: One-Hour Parking: Kenmare Road at Central Avenue
items.summary: Approved one-hour parking from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., Monday through Saturday, along the building on Kenmare Road for LB Music School customer turnover.

items.title: No Overnight Parking Tow Zone: Commercial Street
items.summary: Approved a no overnight parking tow zone between 10 p.m. and 6 a.m. on Commercial Street to deter commercial trucks and tractor-trailers from using the corridor for vehicle storage.

items.title: Off-Agenda Request: Forest Street Parking Variance
items.summary: Tabled a request from an 18 Salem Street resident for a parking variance on Forest Street to the January meeting because it was not listed on the posted agenda.
